metadata.qos: goal/result/cancel/feedback: reliable volatile KeepLast(16); status native defaults; result retention 10 s
metadata.transport: independent processes, localhost DDS, intra-process disabled
metadata.scheduling: single-threaded executor/spin loop; 100 ms wait cap; one goal in flight
metadata.rtt_boundary: before goal submission through acceptance/result observer setup, execution-start readiness service, exactly one validated feedback, feedback acknowledgement or cancellation, and terminal result retrieval
metadata.echo_work: defer execution until readiness confirmation, validate order, publish exact three-element feedback/result; scenario 1 accepts cancellation before Canceled result
metadata.throughput_boundary: complete action lifecycle including validation; excludes discovery/warmup/control rejection protocol
metadata.acceptance_boundary: before submission through accepted goal retrieval and sending the result request; no execution-start handshake
metadata.cancellation_boundary: before cancel request through accepted cancel response retrieval
metadata.auxiliary_protocol: AddTwoInts /ready handshake phase 0 confirms client observation readiness; success phase 1 confirms feedback consumption before completing the result; cancellation instead confirms feedback consumption via the cancel request
metadata.completion_protocol: control goals -1 and -2 rejected after all measured terminal results complete
metadata.host_note: No task-owned builds or tests overlap measurement; unrelated shared-host work on other CPUs observed.
metadata.scope_note: Action lifecycle includes the same readiness/feedback handshakes in Rust and C++; retained native results/status cohort has a 10-second lifetime.
